Construct a structured abstention

Source: R/abstention.R
abstention.Rd

An abstention records why koine declined to issue a fourth opinion, at what scope, and which lenses (if any) were dropped on the way. It is returned as a normal value and surfaces as "abstained" in the downstream triangulation.

Usage

abstention(
  reason,
  scope = c("synthesis", "lens"),
  detail,
  lenses_dropped = NULL
)

Arguments

reason

Single string from the closed taxonomy (Stage-0 SS8).

scope

Either "synthesis" (the whole opinion) or "lens" (a single lens declined).

detail

Human-readable explanation. Required — an abstention with no detail is itself misleading (I1).

lenses_dropped

Optional list of list(id =, reason =) records for lenses dropped before the abstention.

Value

An object of class koine_abstention.

Examples

abstention("no_diverse_battery", detail = "only 1 opinion lens resolved")
#> <koine abstention>
#>   scope : synthesis
#>   reason: no_diverse_battery
#>   detail: only 1 opinion lens resolved
